name: LanGuard
description: LanGuard is a modern, self-hosted network visibility and monitoring tool for discovering, organizing, and tracking devices on your local network (LAN). NOTE: Coordinated 3-Container Setup LanGuard runs as a coordinated 3-service stack using host networking: 1. LanGuard (this template): Next.js web frontend & Caddy reverse proxy on port 8080. 2. LanGuard-Backend : Django REST API, background worker, and SQLite database on port 8000. 3. LanGuard-Scanner : Layer 2 ARP scanner, port prober, and task scheduler. Make sure to install LanGuard-Backend and LanGuard-Scanner alongside this template, or deploy via Unraid's Docker Compose Manager using upstream's docker-compose.yaml. Key Features: - Automated Device Discovery: Discovers IPv4 devices, vendors, MAC addresses, open ports, and active network services. - State & History Tracking: Monitors online/offline availability, IP changes, and device attention alerts. - Inventory Organization: Organize devices by room, role, custom icon, and notes (regular, visitor, IoT, archived). - SNMP & DNS Integrations: Discovers switches, APs, and printers via read-only SNMP v2c. Integrates with AdGuard Home, Pi-hole, Technitium, Speedtest Tracker, and HomeBox. - Multi-Channel Alerts: Instant notifications to Discord, Telegram, ntfy, or custom webhooks when unknown devices appear. - Wake-on-LAN: Wake asleep devices directly from the web interface. Initial Setup: 1. Install LanGuard-Backend first and configure a shared SECRET_KEY . 2. Install LanGuard-Scanner using the same SECRET_KEY . 3. Install LanGuard (Frontend) and open http:// :8080 to create your admin account. Credits & Support: - LanGuard is created by Yossi Hillali ( GitHub | Documentation ).
